Location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role
As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic’s products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities
- Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
- Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic’s GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
- Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
- Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
- Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
- Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic’s products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have
- 7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
- 3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
- Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
- Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
- Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
- Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
- A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have
- 5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
- Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

Logistics
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience.
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience.
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position.
Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, Anthropic expects all staff to be in one of its offices at least 25% of the time. Some roles may require more time in office.
Visa sponsorship: Anthropic says it sponsors visas but cannot successfully sponsor every role and candidate.

# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 USD | Reports to Partnerships (GTM context) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s commercial challenge is not simply model selection or API access. Enterprise value depends on converting a safety-oriented frontier-model brand into repeatable, governed deployments that customers can adopt at scale.

The operating tension is speed versus control: partners need reusable technical patterns, training, and deal support, while Anthropic must preserve product quality, security, and responsible-use expectations across indirect delivery
channels.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a private public-benefit AI company and a hybrid product, platform, and enterprise-adoption business. Its commercial surface spans Claude for business users, developer-facing platform access, and managed agent infrastructure.

Its differentiated DNA is built around reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. That posture makes enterprise implementation credibility, deployment governance, and practical adoption as important as raw model capability.

The dominant motion is increasingly ecosystem-enabled enterprise adoption: product teams supply Claude capabilities, while cloud, technology, and services partners can extend reach into customer architectures, change programs, and industry
workflows.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic must translate a broad platform into durable business outcomes across distinct buyers: business teams using Claude, developers building applications, and enterprises establishing secure operating models.

Claude Enterprise explicitly emphasizes security, compliance, and products for both business teams and developers. That raises the bar for partner-led work: solution patterns must address organizational rollout, not merely technical proof
of concept.

Anthropic’s enterprise deployment guidance frames adoption in four phases: technical setup, change management and launch, enablement and training, and scaling adoption. This suggests decision rights must extend beyond a technical close into
implementation quality and usage expansion.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Anthropic was founded by former OpenAI leaders Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei. Its public identity combines research, engineering, policy, and commercial functions around beneficial AI.

Likely stakeholders include Partnerships and GTM leadership, enterprise sales, product and engineering teams responsible for Claude and the platform, security and compliance stakeholders, and partner technical leadership.

The key internal alignment challenge is translating field and partner deployment feedback into actionable product priorities without treating every strategic implementation as a bespoke roadmap commitment.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Anthropic positions Claude as an AI system designed to be safe, accurate, and secure, using Constitutional AI. That makes responsible deployment architecture a commercial requirement rather than a separate policy conversation.

The Claude platform supports building agents and applications with frontier Claude models and managed agent infrastructure. Architecture conversations can therefore span model access, application integration, agent workflows, operational
controls, and production readiness.

Enterprise adoption material places equal weight on technical setup and organizational enablement. Strong partner architecture should connect platform design to launch planning, administrator readiness, training, and scaled usage.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic publicly presents a network of cloud, technology, and services partners focused on solving customer AI challenges. This is a material ecosystem motion, not a peripheral referral channel.

The partner model creates a three-way operating requirement: Anthropic supplies product expertise and standards; partners bring implementation capacity and customer proximity; cloud and technology partners provide distribution and
architectural context.

The most valuable partner work is likely repeatable joint solution development rather than one-off integrations. Reference architectures, enablement assets, technical validation paths, and structured feedback loops can reduce dependency on
direct specialists.

A published Accenture relationship signals the importance of services-led enterprise deployment. The broader implication is that partner readiness, field credibility, and implementation consistency will influence how effectively Claude
reaches large organizations.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s current public platform positioning includes managed agent infrastructure, expanding the practical surface area partners may need to support beyond standalone chat or basic API use cases.

Its enterprise guidance formalizes adoption as a multi-phase operating journey. That elevates urgency around partner enablement: ecosystem teams need to support launch, training, governance, and expansion before customer implementation
patterns fragment.

Competitive pressure comes from other model providers and cloud ecosystems seeking to become the enterprise default. Anthropic’s partner motion must make Claude straightforward to recommend, implement, govern, and scale within existing
customer environments.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Partner-led enterprise AI architecture and technical co-sell leadership.
- Repeatable implementation patterns for governed AI adoption.
- GSI, cloud, and technology-partner enablement at scale.
- Joint solution development connecting business outcomes to production architecture.
- Technical deal leadership across executives, developers, security, and delivery teams.
- Product-feedback systems grounded in live customer and partner deployments.
- Change management, training, and adoption expansion alongside technical rollout.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic’s partner ecosystem sits at the intersection of Claude platform adoption and enterprise implementation capacity.
- The four-phase enterprise deployment model suggests a focus on durable adoption, not only initial technical activation.
- Managed agent infrastructure broadens the architecture and enablement burden for cloud, GSI, and technology partners.
- Claude’s safety, accuracy, and security positioning makes deployment governance a practical GTM issue.
- The opportunity is to help partners turn frontier-model capability into repeatable customer outcomes.

The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims must come from the governed resume/proof graph.
